description.zh: 视频游戏（玩法优先）蓝图编辑器与运行时 · 演出节点图 + Boss 战 / 血条 / QTE 闯关 / 限时·暂停选择 / 可点热点，新引擎 GameGraph 为唯一 SSOT
description.en: Video-game (gameplay-on-video) blueprint editor & runtime — a graph of performance nodes with boss battles, HP bars, QTE, timed/pause choices, clickable hotspots. The GameGraph engine is the single source of truth.

description.zh: 读取宿主绑定游戏的库文档（原 scenario 形状 + manifest.packs，含主蓝图）；无盘数据时返回 { project: null }。游戏身份由宿主上下文提供。改图前先调它拿现有蓝图与 nodes/edges。
description.en: Read the host-bound game's library document (original scenario shape + manifest.packs including main), or { project: null } when there is no disk data. Game identity comes from the host context. Call before editing to get blueprints and their nodes/edges.

description.zh: 整本覆盖写宿主绑定游戏的 GraphLibraryDocument 到 blueprint.json；首次写入时补 project.json。游戏身份不由工具参数选择。title 当前忽略，成功固定返回 {ok:true, versions:[], gameSlug}；缺 project 时返回 {ok:false, errors}。
description.en: Overwrite the host-bound game's GraphLibraryDocument in blueprint.json and create project.json on the first write. Tool arguments cannot select game identity. title is currently ignored. Success returns {ok:true, versions:[], gameSlug}; a missing project returns {ok:false, errors}.

description.zh: 列出内置演出视频库可用的 media.ref（basename）。编排节点绑视频前先调它看有哪些片段。
description.en: List available built-in performance-video media.ref values (basenames). Call before binding videos to nodes.

description.zh: 第1步·为一个演出节点生成 Seedance V2 镜头脚本（防字幕/一致性/POV 等 prompt IP，纯文本，不落素材层）。生成视频前先拿它作 seedancePrompt。
description.en: Step 1: generate a Seedance V2 shot script for one node (anti-subtitle / consistency / POV prompt IP; text only, no registry write). Get it first as the seedancePrompt before generating video.

description.zh: 第2步·生成一张分镜图/关键帧，落共享素材层。可传 character_ref/scene_ref 作只读参考图、styleAxes 覆盖风格三轴。mode='keyframe'（默认，单帧彩色关键帧→shot_image）或 'grid_storyboard'（6 面板黑白 previs 故事板→grid_storyboard，grid 里可给 nodeRole/endingKind/choiceRevealMoment）。返回 MediaAsset。
description.en: Step 2: generate a keyframe/storyboard image into the shared registry. Pass character_ref/scene_ref as read-only refs and styleAxes to override the 3-axis style. mode='keyframe' (default, single colored keyframe -> shot_image) or 'grid_storyboard' (6-panel B&W previs storyboard -> grid_storyboard; grid.nodeRole/endingKind/choiceRevealMoment steer hard contracts). Returns a MediaAsset.

description.zh: 第3步·为一节点生成一段视频（≤15s 单段），落共享素材层（video_clip）。必传 characterRefIds+sceneRefIds（缺则报错，绝不静默降级）。可传 styleAxes 覆盖三轴、extend+transitionHint 做显式续接。把返回 asset.id 绑到 node.data.media.ref。超长节点用 wb-game-video:generate-node-video。
description.en: Step 3: generate one video segment (<=15s) for a node into the shared registry (video_clip). REQUIRES characterRefIds + sceneRefIds (hard error if missing). Optional styleAxes (3-axis override) and extend+transitionHint (explicit continuation). Bind the returned asset.id to node.data.media.ref. For long nodes use wb-game-video:generate-node-video.

description.zh: 在素材库直接生成一段视频素材（不绑定节点，提示词直传 kino provider）
description.en: Generate a standalone video clip into the asset library (node-free, prompt passed through to the kino provider)

description.zh: 第3步(超长版)·为一节点生成成片，durationSeconds > 15s 时自动拆段；优先使用 Provider 原生视频续接（Kino 直接引用上一段视频），否则才用 ffmpeg 提取真实尾帧。strict 模式在首笔付费任务前预检；可显式传 continuityMode=independent 接受独立分段。必传 character/scene 参考图，返回按序 assets[]。
description.en: Step 3 (long-form): auto-split videos longer than 15s. Prefer provider-native continuation (Kino references the previous video), then fall back to ffmpeg tail-frame extraction. Strict mode preflights before the first paid task; continuityMode=independent explicitly accepts separate segments. REQUIRES character/scene refs and returns ordered assets[].

description.zh: 列出共享素材层的资产（可按 kind/productionType/sceneNodeId 过滤）。挑参考图或查生成产物时用。
description.en: List shared-registry assets (filter by kind/productionType/sceneNodeId). Use to pick reference images or inspect generated outputs.

description.zh: 取单条素材资产（含 status/file/error 等），轮询生成进度或校验绑定用。
description.en: Fetch a single registry asset (status/file/error, etc.) for polling generation progress or verifying a binding.

description.zh: 跨模块只读拿料·读取 wb-character 已产出的角色立绘，通过宿主 media capability 持久化副本并登记成 character_ref；不改角色源目录。生成视频前先备齐角色参考图。
description.en: Cross-module read-only intake: read wb-character portraits, persist copies through the host media capability, and register them as character_ref without modifying the source directory. Call before video generation to stock character references.

description.zh: 跨模块只读拿料·读取场景模块发布到 textures/ 的贴图，通过宿主 media capability 持久化副本并登记成 scene_ref；不改场景源目录。生成视频前先备齐场景参考图。
description.en: Cross-module read-only intake: read scene textures from textures/, persist copies through the host media capability, and register them as scene_ref without modifying the source directory. Call before video generation to stock scene references.
